{{Top|leg}}
'''Cica''' was the largest [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entrus]]. The city had an excess of [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] halls. Moving around the city was made easier by interactive [[Holomap/Legends|holomaps]] that were placed on every street corner.
